integrity: The finite census is replayed by two exhaustive exact enumeration routes. The ordinal-efficiency test is justified by a self-contained trading-cycle argument and agrees with the Bogomolnaia-Moulin criterion.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for strict one-to-one assignment through four agents. The reciprocal-pair characterization is a finite n=4 fact and is not claimed for larger instances.
title: Exact four-agent random-serial-dictatorship ordinal-inefficiency census
